shared_elements: procession/row of human figures in profile
figures in long robes/garments with patterned hems
wheeled vehicle (siege engine / chariot) with spoked wheels
horses/animals in profile drawing a vehicle
architectural elements (crenellations, towers) integrated into the scene
justification: Both are low-relief friezes of profile human figures in long robes moving in a single direction, carrying weapons, combined with a wheeled vehicle on spoked wheels and animals in profile, and both incorporate stepped/crenellated architectural motifs and register-dividing bands; the profile-only convention with overlapping legs and stacked registers is shared. The chief difference in content is the subject: A shows an active assault on a fortified city with archers, a siege engine and city walls, while B shows a calm ceremonial procession of dignitaries beneath a horse-drawn chariot and a rosette border with crenellated parapet.
